title: Coverage Expectation Schema
description: Defines the desired coverage level for a specific business architecture domain within an organisation or business unit.

id.description: Unique identifier for the coverage expectation.

domain.description: The business architecture domain this expectation applies to.

orgUnit.description: The organisation unit this expectation applies to. Leave null if applying to the whole organisation.

targetCoverageLevel.description: The desired level of coverage for the specified domain.

lifecycleStage.description: Optional lifecycle stage this expectation applies to. Used to tailor expectations based on the maturity or development phase of the domain element.

justification.description: Reason for the desired coverage level (e.g. compliance, risk, opportunity).

linkedStrategy.description: Link to the Strategy element supporting this expectation.

createdBy.description: User or system that created this record.
